tool_summary: Opens an interactive FTP session for file transfer. Plain FTP transmits credentials and data unencrypted, distinct from and weaker than sftp/scp, which run over SSH.
platform_notes: ftp behavior is broadly consistent across Linux and macOS, though the specific client (tnftp, lukemftp, or a distro's own) and available flags vary somewhat; core interactive-session behavior covered here is consistent.

rules.description: Opens an interactive FTP session. Unlike sftp/scp, plain FTP transmits credentials and file contents unencrypted over the network, exposing them to interception. Everything done in the session afterward is also invisible to commandant.
